references.text: Israel is called God's firstborn son, illustrating the relationship between God and his people as a father-son bond
Prohibition against cutting the body or making gashes for the dead, the same prohibition found in Deuteronomy 14:1
Priests must not shave their heads or cut their bodies, similar prohibitions against mourning practices
Reference to pagan mourning customs such as self-cutting and shaving the head, which Israel was forbidden to do
The Israelites are called 'children of the living God,' affirming their status as God's children
The Spirit testifies that we are God's children, a New Testament parallel to the concept of being God's children
All are God's children through faith in Christ Jesus, expanding the concept of being God's children
We are called God's children, and indeed we are, a New Testament affirmation of believers as God's children
